sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Time Isolation with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 130. Paralyzes for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 130. Confuses for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Coercion Collapse (decreases all stats of the target by 30%, decreases the target's attack Ability accuracy by 20%, and reduces the target's HP recovery effects by 70%) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 17000
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 50

[Hope's Shooting Star] Seres or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
